scope: Development HTTP range experiment only; product defaults unchanged; LA-037 remains pending.
sourceNote: Both binaries built at product baseline with uncommitted experiment sources. run-01 predates the -rounds CLI flag and always executes four rows; run-02 adds only the row-count option. Measurement functions are the same. Published Go source is in toolCommit; later plot layout adjustment does not change numerical analysis.

checks.result: four complete successful paired rounds; same fixed route, interval and warmup hashes

selection.reason: Tool vet was launched during the first measurement batch. Before running a replacement, the entire first round was conservatively excluded for possible local-load interference. All five arms are preserved. Slow but valid samples in other rounds remain included.

privacy: No full resource URL, raw ETag, CF request ID, username, private path or absolute capture time in evidence. Request and run times are relative to their own batch/run. Private target remains in ignored artifacts.
limitations: one pinned direct IP and observation period
no explicit retry; transparent transport retry not counted
visualization: Optional Matplotlib was installed only in ignored experiment directory after all measurements. An initial sandbox permission failure installing it did not affect measurements.
